note: Theorem G: for the planar six-pin law of [LP] and the good event G_r of [LP] section 7 / [CAP] (1), Q^W(G_r^c) = c_G(b, k) r^3 + o(r^3) with c_G = R(b) J(k) explicit (R closed form; J a Gaussian expectation reduced to one-dimensional integrals and certified on a k-grid). Consumes [LP] (4.1), (4.2), (5.4), (5.5), (7.6)-(7.7) and the definitions of Q, W_r, Z_r, G_r as statements; [CAP] for D, M_3, M_4 and its recorded constant; [NUM] for the exact contact structure and the alpha values; [S] (S2) for the comparison only. Supplies neither C nor r_*: C8 stays OPEN; it shows every cap-route constant C_cap (Q^W(G_r^c) <= C_cap r^3, the bound [LP] (7.8)) on the Math-#195 band exceeds 5.3e6 and locates the cap route's informative range below r = c_G^(-1/3); it gives no lower bound for the constant of [LP] (1.1), which bounds the smaller probability 1 - p_r (v1.2, review 5372981851).

sources.role: sections 1, 3, 4, 5, 7: the law Q, the weight W_r, the normalizer Z_r, the preconditioned contact frame (3.1)-(3.4), the coupling (4.2) and the uniform moments (4.1), the limit (5.4) and the floor (5.5), the good event G_r of section 7 and the bounds (7.5)-(7.8); Theorem A; section 16 lists a numerical r_*, C among the items not supplied

section 1: the cylinder D = [-2r, 2r] x ball(0, 2r), the partial-block norms M_3, M_4 (coordinate partials in d = 2), condition (1); the probabilistic corollary (2)-(3) with C3_new, C4_new for the fixed-axis SIDE24 law (b = 6/5, k = 1/6): the only explicit C on record, compared with c_G(6/5, 1/6) here

exact_structure: the planar contact law (f_yy | even pins ~ N(-b, 2); odd 3-jet | odd pins ~ N(0, diag(2, 2, 6))) used in Theorem G's identification of (w, v, om, Y); prefactor: the values alpha_1, alpha_2 (GH60) quoted in section 5 for the comparison with the true failure coefficient (Math-#168, merged)
Theorem S, (S2): r^-3 (1 - p_r) -> alpha_1 + alpha_2 (the actual planar elder-failure coefficient), quoted for the comparison in section 5 only; not consumed by Theorem G (Math-#170, merged)
